request.question: Write me a four-line poem about the perfect Book of the Month for April. Work the title in.

reply:
Poems aren't on my shelf, and choosing a Book of the Month is a judgment that's yours. I look up figures in the store's data.

I can show revenue, units, orders or average order value, by month or quarter, broken down by genre, format, publisher, weekday, discount or title. What would you like to see?
